sources.excerpt: The end of life of the Tetra Pak packaging refers to 26% recycling , 29.6% incineration and 46.4% landfilling. When recycling, the majority of Tetra Pak recycling plants (97 out of 170)  effectively recycle the 75% of the packaging, which represents the paper fraction. This process yields paper fibers, at a rate of 80% of the paper mass that are used to produce paper products other than packaging .
